chapter.verse: Tua hun sung Sabbath ni-in mangbuh lozau teng tawnin Jesu pai hi. Ama' nungzuite gilkial uh ahih manin buhvuiite zutkhia-in nek kipan uh hi.
Ahi zongin Pharisee-te in a muh uh ciangin Jesu' kiangah, “En in, na nungzuite in Sabbath ni-a hihding phaltheih ahilo na, hih uh hi,” ci uh hi.
Jesu in hih bangin dawng hi: “David a kikholhpihte gilkialin a om laitak amah'n bang hih cih thu simkha ngeilo na hi uh hiam?
Pasian' innpi sungah amah lutin amah leh a kikholhpihte' nek ding phaltheih ahilo, siampite bek' ading ahi, Ompihna anlum ne uh hilo ahi hiam?
Ahihkeileh zong, Sabbath Ni-in biakinn sungah siampite in Sabbath thaangbawl napi mawhbaanglo uh ahihlam Thukhun sungah sim ngeilo na hi uh hiam?
Maantak kong cihin ah biakinn sangin a thupizaw khat hih takah om hi.
‘Biakpiakna sangin thukhualna ka deihzaw hi,’ cih a khiatna thei hileh uhcin mawhbaanglo mite na mawhsiat kei ding uh hi.
Banghanghiam cihleh Mihing' Tapa pen Sabbath' tungah ukna nei ahi hi.”
Tua mun pan Jesu paisuakin Jew mite' vengkhawm inn ah lut hi.
Tua takah khut langkhat a zaw mi khat om hi. Jesu a mawhmat theih nadingun mite in Jesu' kiangah, “Sabbath ni-in cina damsak ding phaltheih ahi hiam?” ci-in dong uh hi.
Jesu in, “No teng lakah tuu a neite na tuu uh Sabbath ni-in dum sungah kia hileh tua tuu lenin a kaito lo ding kua om na hi uh hiam?
Tuu sangin mihing manphazaw tham hi. Tua hi a, Sabbath ni-in nahoih sep ding phaltheih ahi hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin tua mipa' kiangah, “Na khut zankhia in,” ci hi. Tua mipa in a khut zankhia a, a khut hoihkikin a langkhat mah bangin dam hi.
Ahi zongin Pharisee-te pusuak uh a, Jesu bangci suamlup ding ci-in ama' langkhat ah thusim geel uh hi.
Hih thu Jesu in a theih ciangin tua mun pan kihemkhia hi. Mi tampi in amah zui uh a, tuate a vekpi-un damsak hi.
Ahih hangin Jesu in ama' thu mi a theihsak loh nadingun dawite thupia hi.
Tua pen kamsang Isaiah' gen thu a tangtun nading ahi hi:
“En un, ka teelkhiat keima' nasempa, keima' nunna kha hong lungkimsak ka itpa, Ama' tungah ka kha ka nga ding a, amah in Gentile mite' tungah thumaan pulak ding hi.
Amah in thu seel lo-in kikokhia lo ding a, kuamah in konglak ah ama' awging za lo ding hi;
amah in thumaan a gualzawhpih mateng, pumpeng kisatpalh khat kuaitan lo ding a, meivakkhau kuangsa sumit lo ding hi.
Gentile mite in ama' min lamen ding uh hi.”
Tua ciangin Jesu' kiangah khuamulo leh pautheilo dawilut mi khat kipaipih a, Jesu in damsak ahih manin tua mipa pau thei-in khua zong mu thei hi.
Mihonpi bup in lamdang sa mahmah uh a, “Hih mipa David' Tapa ahikha ding hiam?” ci uh hi.
Ahi zongin Pharisee-te in hih thu a zak uh ciangin, “Hih mipa dawite a hawlkhiat pen dawi-uk mangpa Beelzebul' min tawh hi lel hi,” ci uh hi.

Jesu in Pharisee-te' ngaihsutna thei ahih manin amaute' kiangah hih bangin ci hi: “Amahmah a kiphelkhap kumpigam khempeuh kisia ding a, amahmah a kikhenkham khuapi ahihkeileh innkuan khempeuh kip lo ding hi.
Tua mah bangin Satan in Satan a hawlkhiat leh amahmah a kikhenkham ahi hi. Tua ci lehang ama' kumpigam bangci kip ding ahi hiam?
Tua banah Beelzebul' min tawh dawi hawlkhia ka hihleh na tate un kua' min tawh hawlkhia ahi uh hiam? Tua hi a, amau pen note' thukhen hong hiding uh hi.
Ahih hangin dawi ka hawlkhiat pen Pasian' Kha tawh ahihleh note' tungah Pasian' kumpigam hong tung ta ahi hi.
Ahihkeileh zong mi khatpeuh in mi thahatpa hencip masalo pi-in tua mipa' inn sung bangci lutin a neihsate bangci luh thei ding ahi hiam? A hencip khit ciang bekin a inn luh zo pan ding hi.
Kei tawh a pangkhawm lo peuhpeuh kei hong langpang hi a, kei tawh a kholkhawm lo peuhpeuh a thehthang ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin ke'n kong cihin ah mawhna leh Pasian daisakna khempeuh pan mite kimaisak ding a, ahi zongin Kha Siangtho daisakna kimaisak lo ding hi.
Mihing' Tapa langpanna kam a paute kimaisak ding a, ahi zongin Kha Siangtho langpanna kam a pau peuhpeuh tu khanghun sung ahi-a hong tung ding khanghun sung ahi zongin kimaisak lo ding hi.
“Singkung ginaleh a gahte limci a, singkung gina keileh a gahte zong limci lo hi. A hang pen singkungte a gah tungtawnin kithei hi.
No mualtan suante aw, note a gilo kimlai bangci-in thuhoih gen thei ding na hi uh hiam? A hang pen lungsim sunga a dimlet teng kam tawh a kipaukhia ahi hi.
Lungsim a hoih mi in thuhoih a kholna bung sungpan thuhoih suahkhia a, lungsim a sia mi in thusia a kholna bung sungpan thusia suahkhia hi.
Ke'n kong cihin ah mite in a mawk paukhiat uh thu khempeuh thukhen ni ciangin thulela a telgenkik uh kul ding hi.
A hang pen na thugente uh hangin mawhsakna na peng ding uh a, na thugente uh hangin mawhsakna na tuak ding uh hi.”
Tua ciangin laisiamte leh Pharisee-te kimkhat in dawngkik uh a, “Sya aw, nang' tungpan kihilna lim khat ka mu nuam uh hi,” ci uh hi.
Ahi zongin Jesu in hih bangin dawng hi: “A gilo, ciampel angkawm khangmite in kihilna lim khat kal uh a, ahih hangin kamsang Jonah' lim longal a dang kipia lo ding hi.
A hang pen ngapi gil sungah Jonah sun thum zan thum a om mah bangin leitang sungtawng ah Mihing' Tapa sun thum zan thum om ding hi.

Thukhenna hun ciangin hih khangmite' gei-ah Nineveh khuamite dingto-in amaute mawhsak ding uh hi. A hang pen Nineveh khuamite Jonah' thutangkona tawh kisik uh ahih man hi. En un, Jonah sangin a lianzaw khat hih takah om hi.

Thukhenna hun ciangin hih khangmite' gei-ah Leitawlam kumpinu dingto-in amaute mawhsak ding hi. A hang pen amah Solomon' pilna kam a ngai dingin leitung mongte pan hong pai ahih man hi. En un, Solomon sangin a thupizaw khat hih takah om hi.
“Mi khat sungpan kha nin a paikhiat ciangin tui omlohna mun teng nawkin khawlmun a zon hangin mu lo hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, ‘Ka paikhiatna phual ka inn ah ka ciah ding hi,’ ci hi. A tun ciangin tua inn a awngin om a, kiphiatsiangin kipuah sitset hi.

Tua ciangin amah va pai-in amah sanga gilozaw kha dang sagih tonpih a, inn sungah lutin teeng uh hi. Tua mipa' omzia nunung pen a masa sangin siazaw hi. Tua hi a, hih khangmite zong tua bang mah hiding uh hi.”
Mihonpi' kiangah Jesu thugenin a om laitak, en un, a nu leh a sanggamte amah tawh kiho dingin a pua-ah ding uh hi.
Mi khat in ama' kiangah, “En in, na nu leh na sanggamte nang tawh kiho nuamin a pua-ah ding uh hi,” ci hi.
Jesu in tua a genpa' kiangah, “Kua ka nu hi-a kua ka sanggam ahi hiam?” ci hi.
Tua ciangin ama' nungzuite lamah a khut zakphei-in, “Hih takah ka nu leh ka sanggamte om hi.
A hang pen vantunga ka Pa' deihna bang a sem peuhpeuh ka sanggampa, ka sanggamnu leh ka nu ahi uh hi,” ci hi.
